source.description: The field in the event that will be parsed. Default value is message.

delimiter.description: The character separating each column. Default value is ,.

delete_header.description: If specified, the event header (column_names_source_key) is deleted after the event is parsed. If there is no event header, no action is taken. Default value is true.

normalize_keys.description: If set to true, replaces invalid characters with underscore character

multiline.description: If specified, the source key has multiple lines, including header line

quote_character.description: The character used as a text qualifier for a single column of data. Default value is ".

column_names_source_key.description: The field in the event that specifies the CSV column names, which will be automatically detected. If there are additional columns in the source, the column names are automatically generated according to column index. If column_names is also defined, the header in column_names_source_key can also be used to generate the event fields. If too few columns are specified in this field, the remaining column names are automatically generated. If too many column names are specified in this field, the CSV processor omits the extra column names.

column_names.description: User-specified names for the CSV columns. Default value is [column1, column2, ..., columnN] if there are no columns of data in the CSV record and column_names_source_key is not defined. If column_names_source_key is defined, the header in column_names_source_key generates the event fields. If too few columns are specified in this field, the remaining column names are automatically generated. If too many column names are specified in this field, the CSV processor omits the extra column names.

examples.description: Specifies column_one as one of the column names to create

delete_source.description: If true, the configured source field will be deleted after the CSV data is parsed into separate fields.

csv_when.description: A conditional expression such as /some_key == "test". If specified, the csv processor will only run on events when the expression evaluates to true.

examples.description: Only runs the csv processor if the key some_key is null or does not exist.

description: The csv processor parses comma-separated values (CSVs) strings into structured data.
name: csv
